meta.title: Timestamp Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa.
steps_timestamp-converter_1Desc: Paste a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds) or type a human-readable date. The converter automatically detects the input format.
steps_timestamp-converter_2Desc: Results display in multiple formats: Unix seconds, milliseconds, ISO 8601, RFC 2822, and local time strings. All timezone conversions are handled automatically.
steps_timestamp-converter_3Desc: Click any output format to copy it to your clipboard. Ideal for debugging API timestamps, configuring cron jobs, or converting between date representations.
desc: Convert Unix timestamps to human-readable dates and vice versa.
